intro: Katar is pleased that your hatred of the fish men is growing alongside Katar's own, and sends you to hunt further fish men on the beach in the Swamp of Sorrows.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It pleases me to see your hatred for the fish men grows with mine.
Find more of their kind along the beach, and when you've had your fill of combat, return to me. We shall speak then of a reward for your diligence.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Not until the sea and all her children are silenced will I be pleased... Especially those disgusting fish men.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, adventurer. I call for more of their blood. Let all the fish men perish.
